name: com.batchdispatch/mcp
title: Batch Dispatch
description: Search, price and order wholesale stock direct from suppliers. Buyers pay by card via a link.

tools.name: search_lots
tools.description: Search live wholesale lots (bulk stock: clothing by the kg or piece, bales, returns, electronics and more). Returns price per unit, minimum order (moq), stock, supplier country and link.

query.description: Free text, e.g. "carhartt jackets" or "grade A jeans"

currency.description: ISO code the buyer thinks in; adds an approximate converted price

tools.name: get_lot
tools.description: Full details of one lot: description, photos and video, grade, pieces, weight, moq, minimum spend, stock, supplier.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: What is in stock now: live lot count by category, grade and brand.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Exact delivered price before ordering, per supplier: goods, carriage, VAT, the 5% buyer protection fee and total, plus anything blocking the order (supplier minimum, sold out). Creates nothing.

qty.description: Units of the lot's unit (piece, kg, bale...). At least its moq.

country.description: Delivery country, ISO 3166 alpha-2, e.g. GB, DE, US

email.description: Optional buyer email; applies their no-fee referral pairs

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Place the order for a human buyer and get one pay link per supplier. The buyer opens pay_url and pays by card on Stripe; agents cannot pay. Money is held until the buyer confirms the goods arrived. Unpaid orders expire after 24 hours and hold no stock. Confirm the get_quote total with the buyer first.

qty.description: Units of the lot's unit (piece, kg, bale...). At least its moq.

email.description: Buyer email; receipts and tracking go here

agent.description: Name of your agent or app, for our records

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Status of an order (confirmed = awaiting payment, paid, completed). Needs the order reference and the buyer email.

tools.name: request_stock
tools.description: Ask us to find stock the catalogue does not show. We contact matching wholesale suppliers and email their offers to the buyer.

description.description: What, which grade or condition, any brands
